label: The meditator is not IN_ACT_4 in INFINITE_3, formally or eminently
paraphrase: P4 of the idea-of-the-infinite argument, analyst formulation (navigation: Descartes, Meditation III, the meditator who doubts and desires is not perfect; attribution deferred): the meditator is not in act in the perfection of infinite substance (INFINITE_3), neither formally nor eminently (IN_ACT_4). About the meditator only, not about every thinker. Open.
